title: About Sri Anjaneya Youth Association
content: Sri Anjaneya Youth Association is an official youth organization based in Zarugumalli Village, Zarugumalli Mandal, Prakasam District, Andhra Pradesh - 523271, India. The association brings together dedicated local youth and devotees to serve the community through temple seva, religious festivals, free food distribution (Annadanam), blood donation camps, village welfare initiatives, and youth empowerment programs.

title: Mission and Vision
content: The association's mission is to serve God, community, and the village of Zarugumalli through dedicated youth-led initiatives. The vision is to empower youth, preserve temple traditions, and uplift the Zarugumalli community through collective seva and social welfare programs.

title: Location and Address
content: Sri Anjaneya Youth Association is located at Main Road, Zarugumalli Village, Zarugumalli Mandal, Prakasam District, Andhra Pradesh - 523271, India. The primary place of worship and activities is the Sri Anjaneya Swamy Temple in Zarugumalli.
